title: Tam Dew melon: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Tam Dew melon: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Tam Dew melon is a melon variety. 90 to 120 days to harvest, 22.5 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Tam Dew is a registered melon variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1976. It takes 90 to 120 days from sowing to harvest, with 22.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 90 to 120 days from sowing to harvest.
**Yield:** 22.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about Tam Dew melon
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Tam Dew melon takes 90 to 120 days from sowing to harvest. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew).

The pests and diseases that hit melon fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Tam Dew melon

Muskmelon and honeydew need dry weather near harvest, or the fruit cracks and loses its sweetness. Plant so that the fruit ripens before the rains. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 90 to 120 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 22.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tam Dew?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
